 "title": "Create and validate task transform",
 "command": "cat > programs/task-6c32efda.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    # Transpose the input, then reflect it across alternating tile boundaries.
    base = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)]
    h, w = len(base), len(base[0])
    out = []
    for tile_r in range(3):
        for r in range(h):
            src_r = h - 1 - r if tile_r % 2 else r
            row = []
            for tile_c in range(3):
                for c in range(w):
                    src_c = w - 1 - c if tile_c % 2 else c
                    row.append(base[src_r][src_c])
            out.append(row)
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    demo = [[7,6,7],[2,7,6],[1,2,7]]
    expected = [
